about: The far pickpockets (Thieving 2 step T1c), reached by ::tele: Dorgesh-Kaan's cave goblins, Rellekka's nine Fremennik citizens, the Bandit Camp's bandits, Civitas illa Fortis's wealthy citizens, Darkmeyer's vyres, the elves of Lletya and Prifddinas, and Mor Ul Rek's TzHaar-Hur. Each tile and type is mejrs's data_osrs NPCList_OSRS.json (NPCs seen on live, pre-Nov 2022), but for the wealthy citizens (Varlamore came later): their nine tiles are the OSRS Wiki's map, and which of the four looks stands on each is guessed. Wander ranges are guessed (5). Left out: Pollnivneach's bandits (blackjacking), the pirates, Kelyn and Hendor (no live tiles), the elves of Mourning's End's temple. None of these can be attacked yet (no npc-combat.json rows); the quests and capes that gate each area are not checked.
